visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men are indoors; one wearing a black mask and the other with glasses, both smiling and speaking towards a handheld camera in a selfie style. (2) The scene transitions to the open ocean where a diver wearing a blue and red mask and a snorkel is seen floating on the surface, looking directly into the camera with bright daylight overhead. (3) On a moving boat, several young people in black wetsuits and diving gear are seated; one male character is seen leaning over the side, while others are interacting and laughing. (4) Back on land near a harbor, a young man is seen wiping his nose with a white tissue, surrounded by friends who are talking to him; the lighting is bright and natural. (5) Two men are outdoors against a stone wall; one covers his mouth while laughing and looking at the other man who has a mischievous, smiling expression.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 潛水緊急事件不斷. [Slogan]: 暈船嘔吐 腳抽筋 流鼻血. [Subtitle]: 我們準備去. [Logo]: QI黃帝. (2) [Subtitle]: 人生第二次的潛水. (3) [Subtitle]: 媽的超可怕. (4) [Subtitle]: 我這邊不知道是全什麼東西電到. (5) [Subtitle]: 被電到了. (6) [Subtitle]: 黃帝還行嗎 沒關係想吐就吐. (7) [Subtitle]: 他剛剛吐的稀巴爛. (8) [Subtitle]: 你不只要羡慕我不會暈船. (9) [Subtitle]: 還要羡慕我的長相. (10) [Subtitle]: 啊下午還在考慮要不要下去 因為真的蠻不舒服的. (11) [Subtitle]: 天兵是決定已經不下去了 因為他覺得能見度太差. (12) [Subtitle]: 沒有我覺得這絕對是理由. (13) [Subtitle]: 要到指定的地點去 然後這個人的男友不見了 很可憐. (14) [Subtitle]: RAIN的話就是流鼻血 下兩次早上一流次下午流一次. (15) [Subtitle]: 他一定是假借會流鼻血的名義在挖鼻屎. (16) [Subtitle]: 他剛剛抽筋 他如果沒有上來的話 我們就可以再多一個面鏡可以用了.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces the diving trip over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop background track. (2) Transition to outdoor acoustics with subtle wind noise and water splashes as a male voice exclaims about the fear of the ocean. (3) Rapid speech interplay between several young people with laughter; the vocal tone is comedic and high-arousal. (4) Sound of fabric rustling and gentle outdoor ambience as the discussion shifts to physical symptoms like seasickness and nosebleeds. (5) Continuous upbeat BGM maintains a lively pace as the speakers joke about their appearances and shared diving mishaps.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Series of Events -> Humorous Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by sharing a humorous and slightly chaotic record of a group of friends' diving trip, focusing on their unexpected 'emergency' physical reactions.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focuses on personal experiences and social interactions without highlighting a specific product for sale.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a classic social media vlog format with high-density text and fast-paced editing to maintain engagement. The combination of diving footage and 'behind-the-scenes' complaining creates a relatable and funny atmosphere.
